list.title: Mini apps
list.contactEmpty: Ask this contact in chat to build one from your connections, for example “Make me a mini app for last week’s expenses.”
list.contactFooter: Mini apps use this contact’s connections and are visible only to you.
list.groupEmpty: Ask a contact in this group to build one, for example “Make us a shared shopping list.”
list.groupFooter: Group mini apps are shared: every member sees and edits the same saved values. They cannot use connections.

screen.deleteConfirm: Delete {title}? The contact can build it again later.
screen.actionFailed: {label} failed. Nothing was confirmed by the service.
screen.actionUnknown: {label}: the outcome is unknown. Check the service before trying again.
screen.needsReapproval: A connection or tool changed since you enabled this mini app. Review it again to keep using it.
screen.needsReview: Your contact built this mini app. Review what it can do before enabling it.
screen.reads: Runs each time you open or refresh
screen.writes: Only when you tap and confirm
screen.permissionNote: These tools use your connection permissions, and the service decides what each one does. Data is loaded for you only; it is not sent to the contact or saved to memory. Editing the mini app requires review again.

tasks.title: Tasks
tasks.intro: Lists keep shared work in this chat. Contacts can create them, take tasks, wait for blockers, and report results. You can also ask in the chat, for example “Split the trip planning into tasks.”
tasks.cancelListConfirm: Cancel “{title}” and every unfinished task in it? Contacts stop working on them.

work.label: Work
work.info: Work continues with the app closed. Pausing stops new steps and replies; a step already started may finish. Resuming keeps the remaining budget.

research.title: Public web research
research.info: Saving this query authorizes one public search with the app closed. Only this exact query is sent; use public information. Leave empty to revoke. Failed or uncertain attempts count. Daily limits also apply. Changing assignee clears permission; save the assignment first. Reports appear in Docs.
research.note: Saving authorizes one public search with the app closed.

monitor.title: Page monitor
monitor.info: Saving a public page lets the server check it with the app closed, without the model. The contact gets a turn only when the page text changes (and matches a keyword, if set), up to 3 per day and 20 in total. Redirects are not followed; save the final address. Leave empty to remove. Changing assignee removes the monitor; save the assignment first. Pausing or finishing the task stops checks.
monitor.note: Saving lets the server check this page with the app closed.
